headline: The post van takes the corner quiet.
body: A ground-floor door opens and stays open a moment too long. The van leaves no indicator, only a wet mark where the brake held. We keep the margin for the letter that did not come.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: post van, corner taken, brake mark drying

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: sill bright, desk still in the frame's shade
